How to Play?

Meet the Band Tap the four beds. Each cat has its own meow.

Copy the Beat Listen first, then tap the same cats in the same rhythm. Or press 1–4.

Four Rounds Each round gets trickier. You get two misses per game. Win all four for 3 fish treats!

Freestyle Make your own tune before or after the challenge. No scores! After a Good, you can practice again for free.

Kitten Care Feed your cats, help them grow, and unlock new friends and furniture. Your game saves in this browser.
